title: ASC and DBCS leave all character widths unchanged under single-byte editing languages
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088 under en-ZA (a single-byte editing language), ASC(text) and DBCS(text) return text unchanged—leaving full-width ASCII (UNICHAR(65313)&UNICHAR(65345)&UNICHAR(65297)), katakana, hiragana, Hangul, full-width ideographic space (UNICHAR(12288)), and ASCII text unmodified—while coercing numbers and logicals as text, reading blanks as "", and propagating errors. Width conversion occurs only under double-byte editing languages (ja-JP, ko-KR, zh-CN). All 2,090 ASC and 2,101 DBCS full-bank rows match.
basis: Measured across all 24 rows of DnaCalc dczsn3_bytes (Excel 16.0.20527.20088, en-ZA) and f2_rows row 180; 2,090/2,090 ASC and 2,101/2,101 DBCS full-bank rows match.
